title: Can AI design circuit boards yet?
summary: This article benchmarks the current state of AI capabilities in designing printed circuit boards (PCBs), testing various AI tools against real-world circuit design challenges. The author evaluates whether modern AI systems can autonomously handle tasks like schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout routing.
problem_solved: Determines whether current AI systems can replace or assist human engineers in designing functional circuit boards.
why_valuable: Provides empirical evidence about AI's practical limitations in specialized engineering domains, helping the electronics industry understand realistic expectations for AI adoption in hardware design workflows.
